episodes.166999: During cold showers a funnel cloud was reported.
episodes.167330: An ice jam developed in the vicinity of Donnelly Island and Donnelly Brook...on the Aroostook River...during the early morning hours of the 10th. Minor flooding developed upriver from the jam which impacted Gardner Creek Road. Another ice jam developed near Chruchill and Bull Islands...in the vicinity of Crouseville...that afternoon. Flooding from this ice jam impacted Washburn Road with minor flooding. The ice jams released during the early afternoon of the 11th allowing river levels to fall.

events.narrative: Several ice jams impacted portions of the Aroostook River from the vicinity of Washburn to the vicinity of Crouseville. The ice jams developed during the early morning hours of the 10th and persisted into the afternoon of the 11th. Flooding from these ice jams mostly impacted portions of Gardner Creek Road and Washburn Road. The flooding was generally minor. The ice jams released during the afternoon of the 11th allowing river levels to fall.
Funnel cloud was reported via Twitter. Pictures appeared to show a funnel cloud and rotation was noted.
